description: This file defines the Control.Zoom class for the Leaflet mapping library, implementing a zoom control with zoom in and zoom out buttons, including options, event handling, and integration with the Map object.

classes.name: Control.Zoom
classes.description: A control class extending Control, providing zoom in and zoom out buttons with configurable options, and methods to enable, disable, and update the control.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Adds the zoom control to the map, creating buttons and setting up event listeners.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Removes event listeners when the control is removed from the map.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the zoom control, updating its appearance.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the zoom control, updating its appearance.

methods.name: _zoomIn
methods.description: Handles zooming in when the zoom in button is clicked.

methods.name: _zoomOut
methods.description: Handles zooming out when the zoom out button is clicked.

methods.name: _createButton
methods.description: Creates a zoom button element with specified HTML, title, class, and event handler.

methods.name: _updateDisabled
methods.description: Updates the disabled state of zoom buttons based on current map zoom level.
